title: 3 French Books You MUST Read 🇫🇷 (Beginner to Advanced)
description:
📚 Want to read French books but don't know where to start? 🇫🇷 In this video, I share 3 must-read French books for 3 different levels: beginner, intermediate and advanced!
Discover some of the greatest French writers, explore French literature and improve your listening comprehension while learning more about French culture. Whether you're learning French at A2, B1, B2 or C1 level, I hope this video will inspire you to start reading in French! 📖
